coordinate_system: Original source pixels, x rightward, y downward, origin top-left, no resampling or rotation.
numbering: 0 at upper-left enclosed cell; left-to-right then next row; cell_id = 9*row + column.
mask_encoding: Cell_ID_Mask.tif: 0 is outside; values 1..81 encode visible cell IDs 0..80 (mask value = cell ID + 1).
boundary_note: Cut centerlines were traced from each source separately with local directional contrast and continuity; faint/discontinuous cut sections are interpolated. This is a grid annotation, not an adhesion-loss classification.
